about.bio: Rohan grew up in a Fort chawl-turned-apartment building, and has since helped over a thousand families buy, rent and redevelop in the island city. His approach is simple: show fewer, better properties, explain every rupee of cost including stamp duty and society charges, and walk away from any deal with an unclear title. The team is small by design, so every client deals directly with a senior adviser.

faqs.a: Brokerage is shared upfront in writing: typically 1% on resale purchases and one month's rent on leave-and-license deals. There are no other fees and nothing is charged before you sign.

faqs.q: Do you verify titles and RERA registration?
faqs.a: Yes. Before a property is listed with us, we check the title chain, society NOC, occupation certificate and, where applicable, the RERA registration of the project.

faqs.q: Can NRIs buy or rent through you?
faqs.a: Yes. We handle video walkthroughs, power-of-attorney paperwork and coordination with your CA for NRI purchases, and can manage the home after you buy.

faqs.q: How is stamp duty and registration charged?
faqs.a: Stamp duty and registration are paid to the government at actuals. We give you a complete cost sheet, covering stamp duty, registration, legal fees and society charges, before you commit.

faqs.q: Do you help owners redevelop old buildings?
faqs.a: We advise societies on selecting a developer, negotiating corpus and rent terms, and protecting tenant rights. The first meeting is free and carries no obligation.

faqs.q: How do I arrange a site visit?
faqs.a: Use the booking form below to pick a day and time. An adviser will confirm on WhatsApp and meet you at the property. Sunday visits are available from 11 AM to 3 PM.
